summary: Full backend (21 pytest) + frontend (Playwright) testing for Poda v2 (cart multi-items, global counter, branding upload). All 21 backend tests passed. All frontend critical flows passed: 6 product cards, cart merging same variant, badge counter, multi-item cart with total, checkout API returning Stripe URL, empty cart fallback, admin login, branding upload (logo + asso name) appearing in navbar, ship-current button present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _finalize_order_if_paid instantiates StripeCheckout with a dummy webhook_url just to fetch status. Consider refactoring polling so webhook_url isn't required.
server.py: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET not set; webhook signature verification relies on emergentintegrations defaults.
server.py: Single 500-line file is still manageable but starting to mix concerns (models, branding, admin, checkout, webhook). Could split into routers/.
server.py: FastAPI on_event('shutdown') is deprecated — migrate to lifespan handler.
server.py: No unique index on orders.stripe_session_id or settings._id — idempotency relies on update_one with filter; consider adding indexes.
Branding upload accepts any content_type (not validated as image/*). A malformed file is still accepted as long as <2MB. Consider validating mime type prefix 'image/'.
Resend email path is correctly mocked when RESEND_API_KEY is empty (logged), validated by code review (not exercised since payment never completes in tests).
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ orders created via checkout tests (payment_status=initiated, never paid -> do not affect global counter). Branding doc was modified to 'TEST Asso' then reset to 'Poda' with logo deleted at teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_poda_api.py covers v2 schema (items[] cart, global progress, branding upload/delete with X-Admin-Password header and X-Asso-Name header, multipart 'logo' field). Frontend Playwright validated: data-testid product-card-{id}, size-{id}, color-{id}, qty-minus/plus-{id}, add-cart-{id}, nav-cart, nav-cart-badge, cart-item-{i}, cart-total, cart-minus/plus/remove-{i}, submit-checkout, cart-empty, admin-global-stats, admin-branding, admin-logo-input, admin-asso-name, admin-save-asso, admin-current-logo, admin-ship-current, nav-asso-logo. Cart merging behavior verified (same product+size+color increments quantity).
